rules.rule_name: Initialize Program and Open Output Files
rules.rule_description: At program startup, the system captures the current date, displays a startup banner, and opens both the Summary output file and the Details output file in preparation for writing unloaded authorization data.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
1:Program Initialization
Accept current date, display startup messages,
open Summary File and Details File for output

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Pending Authorization Unload program (PAUDBUNL) is invoked
acceptance_criteria.When: The program begins execution
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must: (1) capture the current calendar date and Julian date, (2) display the startup message 'STARTING PROGRAM PAUDBUNL::' along with today's date, (3) open OPFILE1 (Summary Output File) in OUTPUT mode, and (4) open OPFILE2 (Details Output File) in OUTPUT mode, before any database reading or record writing begins

rules.rule_name: Validate Successful Opening of Output Files Before Processing
rules.rule_description: Both output files must be successfully opened before any authorization data processing begins. If either file fails to open, the program must terminate abnormally to prevent data loss or incomplete output.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Files Opened
Successfully?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program has attempted to open OPFILE1 (Summary Output File) and OPFILE2 (Details Output File)
acceptance_criteria.When: The file open status for either OPFILE1 or OPFILE2 is not blank (spaces) and not '00' (successful)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must: (1) display an error message identifying which file failed to open along with its status code, (2) set the program return code to 16, and (3) terminate the program immediately without processing any authorization records

rules.rule_name: Read Next Pending Authorization Summary Record from Database
rules.rule_description: The program sequentially retrieves each Pending Authorization Summary record from the IMS database as the root-level segment, driving the main processing loop for all authorization data extraction.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
2:Read Pending Authorization Summary Record
Retrieve next root-level Summary segment
from IMS database using GN call

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program is in the main processing loop and has not yet reached the end of the Pending Authorization database
acceptance_criteria.When: A Get Next (GN) call is issued to the IMS database for the Pending Authorization Summary segment (PAUTSUM0) using an unqualified SSA
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system retrieves the next available Pending Authorization Summary record and makes it available for validation and further processing

rules.rule_name: Detect End of Pending Authorization Database
rules.rule_description: When the IMS database returns a 'GB' (end of database) status during a Summary record read, the program recognizes that all Pending Authorization Summary records have been processed and signals the main loop to stop.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
10:Detect End of Database
IMS returned GB status -
Mark end-of-database flag as Y

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Get Next (GN) call has been issued to retrieve the next Pending Authorization Summary record
acceptance_criteria.When: The IMS database returns a 'GB' status indicating there are no more Summary records available
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must: (1) set the end-of-database flag to TRUE, (2) set the end-of-root-segment flag (WS-END-OF-ROOT-SEG) to 'Y', and (3) exit the main processing loop and proceed to close output files

rules.rule_name: Terminate Program on Unexpected Summary Read Error
rules.rule_description: If an unexpected error occurs while reading a Pending Authorization Summary record from the database (any status other than successful or end-of-database), the program must terminate abnormally to prevent processing corrupt or incomplete data.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
13:Abnormal Program Termination
Display error message,
Set return code 16, End program

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Get Next (GN) call has been issued to retrieve the next Pending Authorization Summary record
acceptance_criteria.When: The IMS database returns a status code that is neither blank (successful) nor 'GB' (end of database)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must: (1) display the message 'AUTH SUM GN FAILED :' along with the IMS status code, (2) display the Key Feedback Area (PAUT-KEYFB) for diagnostic reference, (3) set the program return code to 16, and (4) terminate the program immediately

rules.rule_name: Validate Account ID is Numeric Before Processing Summary Record
rules.rule_description: Each retrieved Pending Authorization Summary record must have a valid numeric Account ID before it is written to the output file and its associated detail records are processed. Non-numeric Account IDs result in the record being skipped entirely.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
3:Validate Summary Record
Check if Account ID is numeric

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary record has been successfully retrieved from the IMS database
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account ID field (PA-ACCT-ID) on the Summary record is evaluated
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the Account ID is numeric: the summary record is written to the Summary Output File (OPFILE1) and all associated Authorization Detail records are retrieved and written; If the Account ID is NOT numeric: the summary record is silently skipped — it is not written to any output file and no detail records are retrieved for it — and processing continues with the next Summary record

rules.rule_name: Increment Counters Upon Successful Summary Record Retrieval
rules.rule_description: Each time a Pending Authorization Summary record is successfully retrieved from the database, two tracking counters are incremented to maintain an accurate count of records read and processed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
5:Increment Summary Record Counters
Add 1 to total records read counter
and authorization summary processed counter

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary record has been successfully retrieved from the IMS database (status is blank/successful)
acceptance_criteria.When: The successful retrieval is confirmed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must increment both: (1) the total records read counter (WS-NO-SUMRY-READ) by 1, and (2) the authorization summary processed counter (WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT) by 1

rules.rule_name: Write Valid Pending Authorization Summary Record to Output File
rules.rule_description: A Pending Authorization Summary record that passes the numeric Account ID validation is written to the Summary Output File, preserving the full summary data for downstream use.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
4:Write Summary Record to Output File
Move Pending Auth Summary data
to Summary output file record and write it

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary record has been successfully retrieved and its Account ID (PA-ACCT-ID) has been confirmed as numeric
acceptance_criteria.When: The record passes the numeric Account ID validation
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must: (1) copy the full Pending Authorization Summary record (PENDING-AUTH-SUMMARY) to the Summary output file record area (OPFIL1-REC), (2) store the Account ID in the root segment key (ROOT-SEG-KEY), and (3) write the record to OPFILE1 (Summary Output File)

rules.rule_name: Read Next Pending Authorization Detail Record for Current Summary
rules.rule_description: For each valid Pending Authorization Summary record, the program sequentially retrieves all associated child-level Authorization Detail records from the IMS database using a Get Next within Parent call.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
6:Read Pending Authorization Detail Record
Retrieve next child-level Detail segment
from IMS database using GNP call

acceptance_criteria.Given: A valid Pending Authorization Summary record has been written to the output file and the end-of-child-segment flag has not been set to 'Y'
acceptance_criteria.When: A Get Next within Parent (GNP) call is issued to the IMS database for the Pending Authorization Details segment (PAUTDTL1) using an unqualified SSA
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system retrieves the next available Authorization Detail record that is a child of the current Summary record and makes it available for counter incrementing and writing to the Details output file

rules.rule_name: Detect End of Child Detail Segments for Current Summary
rules.rule_description: When the IMS database signals that there are no more child Authorization Detail records for the current Summary record, the program marks the end-of-child flag and returns to process the next Summary record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
9:Detect End of Child Segments
IMS returned GE status -
Mark end-of-child flag as Y

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Get Next within Parent (GNP) call has been issued to retrieve the next Authorization Detail record for the current Summary
acceptance_criteria.When: The IMS database returns a 'GE' status indicating there are no more child Detail records under the current parent Summary record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must: (1) set the end-of-child-segment flag (WS-END-OF-CHILD-SEG) to 'Y', (2) display the message 'CHILD SEG FLAG GE : ' along with the flag value, and (3) exit the child processing loop and return to the main Summary processing loop

rules.rule_name: Increment Counters Upon Successful Detail Record Retrieval
rules.rule_description: Each time a Pending Authorization Detail record is successfully retrieved from the database, two tracking counters are incremented to maintain an accurate running total of all records read and processed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
8:Increment Detail Record Counters
Add 1 to total records read counter
and authorization summary processed counter

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Detail record has been successfully retrieved from the IMS database (status is blank/successful)
acceptance_criteria.When: The successful retrieval of the Detail record is confirmed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must increment both: (1) the total records read counter (WS-NO-SUMRY-READ) by 1, and (2) the authorization summary processed counter (WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT) by 1, and set the MORE-AUTHS flag to TRUE

rules.rule_name: Write Pending Authorization Detail Record to Details Output File
rules.rule_description: Each successfully retrieved Authorization Detail record is written to the Details Output File, capturing the full detail data associated with its parent Summary record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
7:Write Detail Record to Output File
Move Pending Auth Detail data and parent
Account ID to Details output file and write it

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Detail record has been successfully retrieved from the IMS database for the current parent Summary record
acceptance_criteria.When: The Detail record retrieval is confirmed as successful
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must: (1) copy the full Pending Authorization Detail record (PENDING-AUTH-DETAILS) to the child segment record area (CHILD-SEG-REC), and (2) write the record to OPFILE2 (Details Output File)

rules.rule_name: Terminate Program on Unexpected Detail Record Read Error
rules.rule_description: If an unexpected error occurs while reading a Pending Authorization Detail record from the database (any status other than successful or end-of-children), the program must terminate abnormally to prevent incomplete or corrupt detail data from being written.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
13:Abnormal Program Termination
Display error message,
Set return code 16, End program

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Get Next within Parent (GNP) call has been issued to retrieve the next Authorization Detail record
acceptance_criteria.When: The IMS database returns a status code that is neither blank (successful) nor 'GE' (no more child segments)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must: (1) display the message 'GNP CALL FAILED :' along with the IMS status code, (2) display the Key Feedback Area (PAUT-KEYFB) labeled as 'KFB AREA IN CHILD:' for diagnostic reference, (3) set the program return code to 16, and (4) terminate the program immediately

rules.rule_name: Continue Processing Next Summary Record After All Children Are Processed
rules.rule_description: Once all child Authorization Detail records for a given Summary record have been processed (or the Summary was skipped due to non-numeric Account ID), the program loops back to retrieve the next Pending Authorization Summary record from the database.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
11:Process All Summary and Detail Records
Continue processing next Summary record

acceptance_criteria.Given: Either (a) all child Authorization Detail records for the current Summary have been written to the Details Output File, or (b) the current Summary record was skipped due to a non-numeric Account ID
acceptance_criteria.When: The end-of-child-segment flag is set to 'Y' or the Summary record was skipped
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must return to the main processing loop and issue the next Get Next (GN) call to retrieve the following Pending Authorization Summary record from the database, continuing until the end of the database is reached

rules.rule_name: Close Output Files Upon Completion of All Processing
rules.rule_description: After all Pending Authorization Summary and Detail records have been processed and the end of the database has been reached, both output files are closed to finalize the unload output.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
12:Close Output Files
Close Summary File and Details File

acceptance_criteria.Given: The end of the Pending Authorization database has been detected and all records have been processed
acceptance_criteria.When: The program exits the main processing loop
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must: (1) display the message 'CLOSING THE FILE', (2) close OPFILE1 (Summary Output File), (3) close OPFILE2 (Details Output File), and (4) log a warning message if either file does not close successfully, before ending the program normally

rules.rule_name: Program Startup Date Capture and Display
rules.rule_description: At program startup, the system captures the current calendar date and Julian day, then displays a program start banner along with today's date to confirm the processing date for the authorization data unload.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Accept Current Date from System
Accept Current Day from System

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Pending Authorization Unload program (PAUDBUNL) is initiated
acceptance_criteria.When: The program begins its initialization phase
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program must capture today's calendar date and Julian day from the system, display a program start banner message 'STARTING PROGRAM PAUDBUNL::', a separator line, and today's date labeled as 'TODAYS DATE' to confirm the processing date

rules.rule_name: Authorization Summary Output File Must Be Successfully Opened Before Processing
rules.rule_description: The Authorization Summary output file (OPFILE1) must be successfully opened for writing before any database records are read or processed. This ensures the destination for summary records is available prior to processing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Open Summary Output File
OPFILE1

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program has completed date capture and display during initialization
acceptance_criteria.When: The program attempts to open the Authorization Summary output file (OPFILE1) for writing
acceptance_criteria.Then: The file must be opened successfully with a file status of spaces or '00'; if successful, the program proceeds to open the Authorization Details output file

rules.rule_name: Program Must Terminate if Authorization Summary Output File Cannot Be Opened
rules.rule_description: If the Authorization Summary output file fails to open, the program cannot proceed with any processing. The program must display an error message identifying the failed file and terminate immediately with a failure indicator.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Summary File
Opened Successfully?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program attempts to open the Authorization Summary output file (OPFILE1) during initialization
acceptance_criteria.When: The file open operation fails — meaning the file status is neither spaces nor '00'
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program must display an error message 'ERROR IN OPENING OPFILE1:' along with the file status code, and immediately terminate the program abnormally with return code 16, without opening the Details file or reading any database records

rules.rule_name: Authorization Details Output File Must Be Successfully Opened Before Processing
rules.rule_description: After the Summary file is confirmed open, the Authorization Details output file (OPFILE2) must also be successfully opened for writing before any database records are read or processed. This ensures the destination for detail records is available prior to processing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Open Details Output File
OPFILE2

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Summary output file (OPFILE1) has been successfully opened
acceptance_criteria.When: The program attempts to open the Authorization Details output file (OPFILE2) for writing
acceptance_criteria.Then: The file must be opened successfully with a file status of spaces or '00'; if successful, the program proceeds to the database record reading phase

rules.rule_name: Program Must Terminate if Authorization Details Output File Cannot Be Opened
rules.rule_description: If the Authorization Details output file fails to open, the program cannot proceed with any processing. The program must display an error message identifying the failed file and terminate immediately with a failure indicator.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Details File
Opened Successfully?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Authorization Summary output file has been successfully opened and the program attempts to open the Authorization Details output file (OPFILE2)
acceptance_criteria.When: The Details file open operation fails — meaning the file status is neither spaces nor '00'
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program must display an error message 'ERROR IN OPENING OPFILE2:' along with the file status code, and immediately terminate the program abnormally with return code 16, without reading any database records

rules.rule_name: Both Output Files Must Be Open Before Authorization Data Processing Can Begin
rules.rule_description: Processing of Pending Authorization database records can only begin after both the Summary output file and the Details output file have been successfully opened. This is a mandatory prerequisite sequence — both files must be ready before any data is read from the database.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Initialization Complete
Proceed to Read Database Records

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program is in its initialization phase
acceptance_criteria.When: Both the Authorization Summary output file (OPFILE1) and the Authorization Details output file (OPFILE2) have been successfully opened with a file status of spaces or '00'
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program is permitted to proceed to the database reading phase and begin reading Pending Authorization Summary records sequentially

rules.rule_name: Abnormal Program Termination on Critical File or Processing Error
rules.rule_description: When a critical error occurs — such as failure to open either output file — the program must terminate abnormally, display an abend message, and signal failure to the calling environment using a standardized return code of 16.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Abnormal Program Termination
Display Error Message for Summary File
End Program with Return Code 16

acceptance_criteria.Given: A critical error has occurred during program initialization, such as failure to open the Authorization Summary output file or the Authorization Details output file
acceptance_criteria.When: The abnormal termination routine is invoked
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program must display the message 'IMSUNLOD ABENDING ...', set the program return code to 16 to signal failure to the calling environment, and immediately stop all processing

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Next Pending Authorization Summary Record from Database
rules.rule_description: The program sequentially retrieves the next Pending Authorization Summary record from the IMS Pending Authorization database using an unqualified Get Next call, processing all root-level summary segments one at a time.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Retrieve Next Summary Record from Pending Authorization Database using Get Next call

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Pending Authorization database is accessible and the program is positioned to read the next available root-level Pending Authorization Summary segment
acceptance_criteria.When: A Get Next request is issued to the Pending Authorization database to retrieve the next sequential Pending Authorization Summary record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The next Pending Authorization Summary record is retrieved from the database and made available for further processing, including Account ID validation and output file writing

rules.rule_name: Increment Processing Counters on Successful Summary Record Retrieval
rules.rule_description: When a Pending Authorization Summary record is successfully retrieved from the database, the program increments both the total summary records read counter and the authorization summary processed counter to track processing volumes.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Was Record Retrieved Successfully?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Get Next call has been issued to the Pending Authorization database for the next Summary record
acceptance_criteria.When: The record retrieval is successful, indicated by a blank database status
acceptance_criteria.Then: The total number of summary records read is incremented by 1, and the total number of authorization summary records processed is incremented by 1, and the retrieved Pending Authorization Summary record is staged for Account ID validation

rules.rule_name: Validate Account ID is Numeric Before Writing Summary Record
rules.rule_description: Before writing a successfully retrieved Pending Authorization Summary record to the output file, the program validates that the Account ID field contains only numeric characters. Only records with a valid numeric Account ID are written to the Summary output file and have their associated detail records processed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Account ID Numeric?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary record has been successfully retrieved from the database and the summary record read and processed counters have been incremented
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account ID field (PA-ACCT-ID) on the retrieved Pending Authorization Summary record is evaluated
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the Account ID contains only numeric characters, the Summary record is written to Output File 1 and processing continues to retrieve associated Authorization Detail records; if the Account ID contains any non-numeric characters, the record is skipped entirely — it is not written to any output file and no associated detail records are retrieved — and the program proceeds to read the next Pending Authorization Summary record

rules.rule_name: Skip Pending Authorization Summary Record with Invalid Non-Numeric Account ID
rules.rule_description: A Pending Authorization Summary record whose Account ID is not entirely numeric is considered invalid and is silently skipped. No output is produced for the record and no associated Authorization Detail records are retrieved. Processing resumes with the next Summary record in the database.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Skip Record - Invalid Account ID, Read Next Summary Record

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary record has been successfully retrieved from the Pending Authorization database
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account ID field (PA-ACCT-ID) on the Summary record is found to contain non-numeric characters
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Summary record is not written to Output File 1, no Authorization Detail records are retrieved for this Summary, no error or warning is raised, and the program immediately proceeds to retrieve the next Pending Authorization Summary record from the database

rules.rule_name: Detect End of Pending Authorization Database and Stop Summary Processing
rules.rule_description: When the Get Next call to the Pending Authorization database returns an end-of-database condition, the program recognizes that all Pending Authorization Summary records have been processed and stops the main processing loop.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: End of Database Reached - Stop Processing All Summary Records

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program is sequentially reading Pending Authorization Summary records from the database
acceptance_criteria.When: The database returns an end-of-database condition (no more records exist) in response to the Get Next call
acceptance_criteria.Then: The end-of-database flag is set to true, the end-of-root-segment processing flag is set to 'Y', the main Summary record processing loop is terminated, and the program proceeds to close output files and end

rules.rule_name: Terminate Program on Unexpected Error Reading Pending Authorization Summary
rules.rule_description: If the Pending Authorization database returns any status other than a successful retrieval or an end-of-database condition when reading a Summary record, the program treats this as an unrecoverable error and terminates abnormally, signaling failure to the calling environment.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Unexpected Error Encountered - Abnormal Program Termination

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Get Next call has been issued to the Pending Authorization database to retrieve the next Pending Authorization Summary record
acceptance_criteria.When: The database returns a status that is neither a successful retrieval (blank status) nor an end-of-database condition, indicating an unexpected error
acceptance_criteria.Then: An error message is displayed identifying the failure on the Authorization Summary Get Next call along with the key feedback area details, the program terminates abnormally, and a return code of 16 is set to signal failure to the calling environment

rules.rule_name: Extract Account ID from Pending Authorization Summary Record
rules.rule_description: When a Pending Authorization Summary record is successfully retrieved from the database, the Account ID must be extracted from the record and stored as the key identifier before any validation or processing can occur.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Extract Account ID from Pending Authorization Summary Record

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary record has been successfully retrieved from the Pending Authorization database
acceptance_criteria.When: The program prepares to validate and process the retrieved summary record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Account ID (PA-ACCT-ID) is extracted from the Pending Authorization Summary record and stored as the root segment key identifier for subsequent validation and processing

rules.rule_name: Validate Account ID is Numeric in Pending Authorization Summary
rules.rule_description: Each retrieved Pending Authorization Summary record must have its Account ID validated to ensure it contains only numeric characters. This validation acts as a data integrity gate that determines whether the record is eligible for output and further processing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Account ID Numeric?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary record has been retrieved from the Pending Authorization database and the Account ID has been extracted from the record
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account ID field (PA-ACCT-ID) is evaluated for its data content
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the Account ID contains only numeric digits, the record is accepted as valid and eligible for processing; if the Account ID contains any non-numeric characters, the record is rejected and flagged to be skipped

rules.rule_name: Write Valid Pending Authorization Summary Record to Summary Output File
rules.rule_description: A Pending Authorization Summary record that passes the numeric Account ID validation must be written to the Summary Output File. Only records with valid numeric Account IDs are persisted to the output, ensuring the output file contains only clean, processable authorization summary data.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:

Write Summary Record to
Summary Output File and
Proceed to Read Detail Records

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary record has been retrieved from the Pending Authorization database and its Account ID has been validated as numeric
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account ID is confirmed to be numeric
acceptance_criteria.Then: The complete Pending Authorization Summary record is written to the Summary Output File (OPFILE1), making it available for downstream consumption

rules.rule_name: Trigger Detail Record Processing for Valid Pending Authorization Summary
rules.rule_description: After a valid Pending Authorization Summary record (with a numeric Account ID) is written to the Summary Output File, the program must proceed to retrieve and process all associated Authorization Detail records. Detail processing is exclusively triggered for summaries that pass the numeric Account ID validation.

Proceed to Read Detail Records

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary record with a valid numeric Account ID has been written to the Summary Output File
acceptance_criteria.When: The summary record is accepted as valid
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program initiates the retrieval and processing of all child Authorization Detail records associated with the current Summary record, continuing until all detail records for that summary have been processed and written to the Detail Output File

rules.rule_name: Reject and Skip Pending Authorization Summary with Non-Numeric Account ID
rules.rule_description: A Pending Authorization Summary record whose Account ID contains non-numeric characters must be entirely excluded from processing. Neither the summary record nor any of its associated Authorization Detail records are written to any output file. The program silently skips the record and moves on to the next summary.

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary record has been retrieved from the Pending Authorization database and its Account ID has been evaluated
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account ID is found to contain non-numeric characters
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Pending Authorization Summary record is not written to the Summary Output File, no Authorization Detail records associated with this summary are retrieved or written to the Detail Output File, no error or warning is raised, and the program proceeds directly to retrieve the next Pending Authorization Summary record from the database

rules.rule_name: Stage Pending Authorization Summary Data for Output
rules.rule_description: When a Pending Authorization Summary record is successfully retrieved from the database, its data must be staged into the Summary Output File record area in preparation for writing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Move Pending Authorization Summary data to Summary Output File Record

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary record has been successfully retrieved from the Pending Authorization database
acceptance_criteria.When: The program prepares to write the Authorization Summary to the output file
acceptance_criteria.Then: The complete Pending Authorization Summary data must be copied into the Summary Output File record area, making it ready for output

rules.rule_name: Capture Account ID as the Record Identifier Key
rules.rule_description: The Account ID from the Pending Authorization Summary record must be captured and stored as the Root Segment Key to uniquely identify the record and serve as the basis for subsequent validation and child record retrieval.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Capture Account ID as Root Segment Key

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary record has been staged into the Summary Output File record area
acceptance_criteria.When: The program extracts the identifying key from the Authorization Summary
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Account ID (PA-ACCT-ID) from the Pending Authorization Summary must be captured and stored as the Root Segment Key, and both the Root Segment Key and Child Segment Record areas must be cleared before the Account ID is stored

rules.rule_name: Validate Account ID Must Be Numeric
rules.rule_description: Before writing an Authorization Summary record to the output file, the Account ID must be validated to ensure it contains only numeric characters. Records with non-numeric Account IDs are considered invalid and must be excluded from output processing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Account ID Numeric?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary record has been retrieved and its Account ID has been captured as the Root Segment Key
acceptance_criteria.When: The program evaluates the Account ID value
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the Account ID contains only numeric characters, the record is considered valid and eligible for output; if the Account ID contains any non-numeric characters, the record is considered invalid and must be skipped entirely — no summary record is written and no associated detail records are processed

rules.rule_name: Write Valid Authorization Summary Record to Summary Output File
rules.rule_description: An Authorization Summary record that has passed the numeric Account ID validation must be written to the Summary Output File to be included in the unload output.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Write Summary Record to Summary Output File

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary record has been staged in the Summary Output File record area and its Account ID has been confirmed as numeric
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account ID validation passes
acceptance_criteria.Then: The staged Summary Output File record must be written to the Summary Output File (Output File 1), making the Authorization Summary data available in the output

rules.rule_name: Skip Authorization Summary Record with Invalid Account ID
rules.rule_description: An Authorization Summary record whose Account ID is not numeric must be excluded from all output processing. Neither the summary record nor any of its associated Authorization Detail records will be written to any output file.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: End: Record Skipped

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary record has been retrieved from the Pending Authorization database and its Account ID has been evaluated
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account ID is found to be non-numeric
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Authorization Summary record must not be written to the Summary Output File, no Authorization Detail records associated with this summary must be retrieved or written to the Detail Output File, and the program must proceed to retrieve the next Authorization Summary record without generating any error or warning

rules.rule_name: Validate Successful Retrieval of Authorization Summary Record Before Counter Update
rules.rule_description: Before incrementing any counters, the program must confirm that the IMS database call to retrieve the next Pending Authorization Summary record was successful. Only a successful retrieval (indicated by a blank/spaces status) qualifies the record for further processing and counter updates.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: IMS GN Call Successful?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program has issued a request to retrieve the next Pending Authorization Summary record from the IMS database
acceptance_criteria.When: The IMS database retrieval status is blank/spaces, indicating a successful record retrieval
acceptance_criteria.Then: The record is considered valid and eligible for counter increments and further processing; if the retrieval status is not blank/spaces, no counters are updated and the record is skipped

rules.rule_name: Validate Numeric Account ID on Authorization Summary Record
rules.rule_description: After a successful retrieval of a Pending Authorization Summary record, the Account ID field (PA-ACCT-ID) must be validated to confirm it contains a numeric value. Only records with a numeric Account ID are eligible for counter increments, output writing, and child detail processing. Records with non-numeric Account IDs are silently skipped.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Account ID Is Numeric?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary record has been successfully retrieved from the IMS database
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account ID (PA-ACCT-ID) on the retrieved summary record is evaluated for numeric content
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the Account ID is numeric, the record proceeds to counter increments and output processing; if the Account ID is not numeric, the record is skipped entirely with no counters updated, no output written, and no child detail records processed

rules.rule_name: Increment Total Summary Records Read Counter
rules.rule_description: Each time a Pending Authorization Summary record is successfully retrieved from the IMS database and its Account ID is confirmed as numeric, the total summary records read counter (WS-NO-SUMRY-READ) must be incremented by 1 to track the cumulative count of valid summary records read during the program run.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Add 1 to Total Summary Records Read Counter WS-NO-SUMRY-READ

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary record has been successfully retrieved from the IMS database and the Account ID (PA-ACCT-ID) has been confirmed as numeric
acceptance_criteria.When: The program processes the valid summary record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The total summary records read counter (WS-NO-SUMRY-READ) is incremented by exactly 1

rules.rule_name: Increment Authorization Summary Processed Counter
rules.rule_description: Immediately after incrementing the total summary records read counter, the authorization summary processed counter (WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT) must also be incremented by 1 for each valid summary record (successful retrieval with numeric Account ID), tracking the number of authorization summaries that have been fully processed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Add 1 to Authorization Summary Processed Counter WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT

acceptance_criteria.Given: The total summary records read counter (WS-NO-SUMRY-READ) has just been incremented by 1 for a valid Pending Authorization Summary record
acceptance_criteria.When: The program continues processing the same valid summary record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The authorization summary processed counter (WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT) is incremented by exactly 1, and the program continues to write the summary record to the output file

rules.rule_name: Skip Counter Updates and Processing for Invalid Account ID
rules.rule_description: When a successfully retrieved Pending Authorization Summary record contains a non-numeric Account ID, the record must be entirely excluded from all processing — no counters are incremented, no output is written to the Summary output file, and no child Authorization Detail records are fetched or written.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Skip - Invalid Account ID

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary record has been successfully retrieved from the IMS database
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account ID (PA-ACCT-ID) on the summary record is found to be non-numeric
acceptance_criteria.Then: Neither the total summary records read counter (WS-NO-SUMRY-READ) nor the authorization summary processed counter (WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT) is incremented, no summary record is written to Output File 1, and no child Authorization Detail records are retrieved or written to Output File 2

rules.rule_name: Skip All Processing for Unsuccessful Summary Record Retrieval
rules.rule_description: When the IMS database retrieval of a Pending Authorization Summary record does not return a successful status (blank/spaces), the program must not increment any counters, not write any output, and not attempt to retrieve any child detail records for that iteration.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Skip - Unsuccessful Retrieval

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program has issued a request to retrieve the next Pending Authorization Summary record from the IMS database
acceptance_criteria.When: The IMS database retrieval status is not blank/spaces (i.e., the retrieval was not successful — excluding end-of-database status 'GB' which is handled separately)
acceptance_criteria.Then: Neither the total summary records read counter (WS-NO-SUMRY-READ) nor the authorization summary processed counter (WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT) is incremented, no output is written, and the program either sets the end-of-database flag or terminates with an error depending on the specific status returned

rules.rule_name: Retrieve Next Pending Authorization Detail Record for Current Summary
rules.rule_description: For each valid Pending Authorization Summary record being processed, the system must retrieve the next associated child-level Authorization Detail record from the Pending Authorization Details data store (PAUTDTL1) using a Get Next within Parent retrieval strategy, ensuring only detail records belonging to the current parent summary are fetched.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 6: Read Pending Authorization Detail Record - For each summary record, retrieve the next child-level Pending Authorization Detail segment from the IMS database using an unqualified Get Next within Parent (GNP) call

acceptance_criteria.Given: A valid Pending Authorization Summary record has been successfully read and written to the Summary Output File, and the child detail retrieval loop has been initiated for that summary
acceptance_criteria.When: The system requests the next child-level Pending Authorization Detail record from the PAUTDTL1 data store that is a direct child of the current Pending Authorization Summary record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system retrieves the next available Pending Authorization Detail record scoped strictly to the current parent Summary record, and the retrieval result status is evaluated to determine the next processing action

rules.rule_name: Process Successfully Retrieved Authorization Detail Record
rules.rule_description: When a Pending Authorization Detail record is successfully retrieved from the data store for the current Summary record, the system must mark that more authorization details exist and proceed to increment processing counters and write the detail record to the output file.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Detail Record Found Successfully

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Get Next within Parent retrieval has been executed for the Pending Authorization Detail segment of the current Summary record
acceptance_criteria.When: The retrieval is successful, meaning a Pending Authorization Detail record exists and has been returned without any error
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system confirms that more authorization detail records exist for the current summary (sets MORE-AUTHS flag to TRUE) and proceeds to increment the processing counters and write the detail record to the Details Output File

rules.rule_name: Increment Processing Counters for Each Authorization Detail Record Retrieved
rules.rule_description: Each time a Pending Authorization Detail record is successfully retrieved, two running counters must be incremented by 1: the Total Records Read Counter (tracking all records read across the program) and the Authorization Summary Processed Counter (tracking the number of authorization records processed in the current run).
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 8: Increment Detail Record Counters - Add 1 to Total Records Read Counter, Add 1 to Authorization Summary Processed Counter

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Detail record has been successfully retrieved from the PAUTDTL1 data store for the current parent Summary record
acceptance_criteria.When: The system confirms the successful retrieval of the detail record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Total Records Read Counter (WS-NO-SUMRY-READ) is incremented by 1, AND the Authorization Summary Processed Counter (WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT) is incremented by 1, reflecting the newly retrieved detail record in both running totals

rules.rule_name: Write Authorization Detail Record to Details Output File
rules.rule_description: After successfully retrieving a Pending Authorization Detail record and incrementing the counters, the detail data must be moved to the Details Output File record area and written to the Details Output File (OPFILE2), creating a permanent output record for downstream processing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 7: Write Detail Record to Output File - Move Pending Auth Detail Data and Parent Account ID to Details Output File Record and Write it

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Detail record has been successfully retrieved and the processing counters have been incremented
acceptance_criteria.When: The system prepares the output record by moving the Pending Authorization Detail data into the Details Output File record area
acceptance_criteria.Then: The complete Pending Authorization Detail record is written to the Details Output File (OPFILE2), producing one output record per successfully retrieved detail segment

rules.rule_name: Detect End of Authorization Detail Records for Current Summary
rules.rule_description: When the data store signals that no more Pending Authorization Detail records exist under the current parent Summary record, the system must mark the End-of-Child processing flag as 'Y' to exit the detail retrieval loop and return control to the Summary-level processing loop to fetch the next Summary record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 9: Detect End of Child Segments - No More Detail Records Exist for Current Summary Record, Mark End-of-Child Flag as Y

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is iterating through child-level Pending Authorization Detail records for the current parent Summary record
acceptance_criteria.When: The retrieval of the next detail record returns a 'No More Children' (GE) status, indicating that all detail records for the current Summary have already been processed
acceptance_criteria.Then: The End-of-Child processing flag (WS-END-OF-CHILD-SEG) is set to 'Y', the system displays a message confirming the end-of-child condition, and the detail retrieval loop is exited so that processing returns to retrieve the next Pending Authorization Summary record

rules.rule_name: Terminate Program on Unexpected Error During Authorization Detail Retrieval
rules.rule_description: If an unexpected error occurs during the retrieval of a Pending Authorization Detail record — any status other than successful retrieval or end-of-children — the system must immediately display diagnostic information including the error status and the key feedback area, then terminate the program abnormally with a return code of 16 to signal failure to the calling environment.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: 13: Abnormal Program Termination - Display Error Message, Set Return Code 16, End Program

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has attempted to retrieve the next Pending Authorization Detail record for the current Summary record
acceptance_criteria.When: The retrieval returns a status that is neither a successful retrieval (blank status) nor an end-of-children indicator (GE status), representing an unexpected data retrieval failure
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system displays the error message 'GNP CALL FAILED' along with the actual error status code, displays the Key Feedback Area (PAUT-KEYFB) containing the database key information at the point of failure, sets the program return code to 16 to signal abnormal termination, and ends the program immediately without processing any further records

rules.rule_name: Capture Parent Account ID as Linking Key for Detail Records
rules.rule_description: When a Pending Authorization Summary record has been successfully validated (numeric Account ID), the Account ID from the parent Summary record must be captured and stored as the root segment key so that child Detail records can be linked back to their parent Summary.

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary record has been successfully retrieved from the IMS database and its Account ID (PA-ACCT-ID) has been confirmed as numeric
acceptance_criteria.When: The program prepares to process the child Authorization Detail records belonging to that Summary
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Root Segment Key is cleared and the parent Summary Account ID is stored as the Root Segment Key to serve as the linking reference between the parent Summary and all its child Detail records

rules.rule_name: Populate Detail Output Record with Pending Authorization Detail Data
rules.rule_description: When a Pending Authorization Detail record is successfully retrieved from the IMS database under a valid parent Summary, the full content of the Detail segment must be moved into the Details output file record area in preparation for writing.

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Detail record has been successfully retrieved from the IMS database as a child of the current Pending Authorization Summary record
acceptance_criteria.When: The database read status confirms a successful retrieval (no error condition)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The complete Pending Authorization Detail data is moved into the child segment output record area, populating all fields of the Details output record with the retrieved Detail segment data

rules.rule_name: Increment Processing Counters Upon Successful Detail Record Retrieval
rules.rule_description: Each time a Pending Authorization Detail record is successfully retrieved from the IMS database, both the total records read counter and the authorization summary processed counter must be incremented to track processing volume.

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program is processing child Authorization Detail records under a valid parent Authorization Summary record
acceptance_criteria.When: A Pending Authorization Detail record is successfully retrieved from the IMS database (no error condition on retrieval)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The total number of summary records read counter is incremented by 1, and the total authorization summary processed count is also incremented by 1, reflecting the successful retrieval of one additional Detail record

rules.rule_name: Write Authorization Detail Record to Details Output File
rules.rule_description: After the Pending Authorization Detail data has been populated into the output record area, the combined Detail record must be written to the Details output file (OPFILE2), creating a persistent unloaded copy of the Authorization Detail data.

acceptance_criteria.When: The Detail output record is ready with the full Authorization Detail data
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Detail record is written to the Details output file (Output File 2), producing one output record per successfully retrieved Authorization Detail segment

rules.rule_name: Link Authorization Detail Records to Parent Summary via Account ID
rules.rule_description: Each Authorization Detail record written to the output file must carry the parent Summary's Account ID as a linking key, ensuring that Detail records can be associated back to their originating Authorization Summary record in downstream processing.

acceptance_criteria.When: Each Authorization Detail record is prepared for output
acceptance_criteria.Then: The child Detail output record is associated with the parent Account ID stored in the Root Segment Key, so that every Detail record written to Output File 2 is traceable to its parent Authorization Summary record via the Account ID

rules.rule_name: Mark More Authorizations Available Upon Successful Detail Record Retrieval
rules.rule_description: When a Pending Authorization Detail record is successfully retrieved from the database, the system must flag that more authorization records are available for processing under the current Authorization Summary.

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is processing child Authorization Detail records under a valid Pending Authorization Summary record with a numeric Account ID, and a Get-Next-within-Parent database call has been issued to retrieve the next Authorization Detail record
acceptance_criteria.When: The Authorization Detail record is successfully retrieved from the database (i.e., the database read status indicates a successful retrieval with no errors)
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must set the 'More Authorizations Available' flag to TRUE, indicating that at least one Authorization Detail record exists and is available under the current Authorization Summary parent record

rules.rule_name: Increment Total Records Read Counter for Each Valid Authorization Detail Record
rules.rule_description: Each time a Pending Authorization Detail record is successfully retrieved from the database, the total records read counter must be incremented by 1 to maintain an accurate running count of all records processed across both summary and detail record types.

acceptance_criteria.When: A valid Authorization Detail record has been confirmed as successfully retrieved
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Total Records Read Counter (WS-NO-SUMRY-READ) must be incremented by exactly 1, accumulating the count of all successfully read records — both Authorization Summary and Authorization Detail records — throughout the entire program execution

rules.rule_description: Each time a Pending Authorization Detail record is successfully retrieved from the database, the Authorization Summary Processed Counter must also be incremented by 1, tracking the cumulative number of authorization-related records (both summary and detail) that have been processed during the program run.

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system has successfully retrieved a Pending Authorization Detail record from the database under a valid Authorization Summary with a numeric Account ID, and the Total Records Read Counter (WS-NO-SUMRY-READ) has already been incremented by 1 for this record
acceptance_criteria.When: The Total Records Read Counter increment has been completed for the current Authorization Detail record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Authorization Summary Processed Counter (WS-AUTH-SMRY-PROC-CNT) must be incremented by exactly 1, maintaining a cumulative count of all authorization-related records — both Authorization Summary and Authorization Detail records — that have been successfully processed during the current program execution

rules.rule_name: Detect End of Authorization Detail Records for Current Summary
rules.rule_description: When the system attempts to retrieve the next Authorization Detail record under a given Authorization Summary and finds no more detail records exist, it must mark the end-of-child-segment indicator to stop further detail retrieval for that summary.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Detect End of Child Segments - When the IMS GNP Call returns a 'GE' (Segment Not Found) status, mark the end-of-child-segment flag as 'Y' to stop reading detail records for the current summary

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is reading Authorization Detail records associated with a specific Pending Authorization Summary record, and a request has been made to retrieve the next Authorization Detail record from the database
acceptance_criteria.When: The database returns a 'Segment Not Found' response indicating there are no more Authorization Detail records under the current Authorization Summary
acceptance_criteria.Then: The end-of-child-segment flag must be set to 'Y', signaling that all Authorization Detail records for the current Authorization Summary have been fully processed and no further detail retrieval should occur for this summary

rules.rule_name: Stop Reading Detail Records When End-of-Child Flag Is Set
rules.rule_description: Once the end-of-child-segment flag is marked as 'Y', the system must immediately stop attempting to read further Authorization Detail records for the current Authorization Summary and return control to the Authorization Summary processing loop.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is End-of-Child-Segment Flag = Y? → Stop Reading Detail Records for Current Summary Record → Return to Summary Processing

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is in the process of reading Authorization Detail records for a specific Pending Authorization Summary, and the end-of-child-segment flag has been evaluated
acceptance_criteria.When: The end-of-child-segment flag is found to be equal to 'Y'
acceptance_criteria.Then: The system must stop reading Authorization Detail records for the current Authorization Summary and return to the main Authorization Summary processing loop to fetch the next Authorization Summary record

rules.rule_name: Continue Reading Next Authorization Detail Record When More Records Exist
rules.rule_description: When the database successfully returns an Authorization Detail record (indicated by a blank status), the system must continue processing and attempt to read the next Authorization Detail record under the same Authorization Summary.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Status Code = GE? Segment Not Found → No - Other Status → Continue Reading Next Detail Record

acceptance_criteria.Given: The system is reading Authorization Detail records associated with a specific Pending Authorization Summary record, and a request has been made to retrieve the next Authorization Detail record
acceptance_criteria.When: The database returns a successful response with a blank status, indicating an Authorization Detail record was found and retrieved
acceptance_criteria.Then: The end-of-child-segment flag remains unset (not 'Y'), the system continues the detail reading loop, and the next Authorization Detail record under the same Authorization Summary is requested

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program is sequentially reading Pending Authorization Summary records from the IMS database one at a time, and at least one prior read attempt has been made

rules.rule_name: Read Next Pending Authorization Summary Record from Database
rules.rule_description: The program sequentially retrieves the next Pending Authorization Summary record from the IMS database to begin processing it.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Read Next Pending Authorization Summary Record from Database

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program is processing Pending Authorization Summary records and has not yet reached the end of the database
acceptance_criteria.When: A request is made to retrieve the next Pending Authorization Summary record from the database using an unqualified sequential read
acceptance_criteria.Then: The next available Pending Authorization Summary record is retrieved and made available for validation and output processing, with the summary read counter and authorization summary processed counter each incremented by 1

rules.rule_name: Detect End of Pending Authorization Database
rules.rule_description: When all Pending Authorization Summary records have been read, the program detects the end-of-database condition and stops further processing.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: End of Database Reached?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program is sequentially reading Pending Authorization Summary records from the database
acceptance_criteria.When: The database returns an end-of-database signal indicating no more Pending Authorization Summary records exist
acceptance_criteria.Then: The end-of-database flag is set to TRUE and the end-of-root-segment flag is set to 'Y', causing the main processing loop to terminate and the program to proceed to close output files

rules.rule_name: Validate Account ID is Numeric Before Processing
rules.rule_description: Before writing a Pending Authorization Summary record to the output file, the Account ID must be validated to ensure it contains only numeric characters.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Is Account ID Numeric?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary record has been successfully retrieved from the database
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account ID field on the retrieved Pending Authorization Summary record is evaluated
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the Account ID contains only numeric characters, the summary record is eligible for output and its associated detail records are processed; if the Account ID contains any non-numeric characters, the summary record is skipped entirely along with all its associated Authorization Detail records, and processing moves to the next summary record

rules.rule_name: Write Valid Pending Authorization Summary Record to Summary Output File
rules.rule_description: A Pending Authorization Summary record that has passed the numeric Account ID validation is written to the Summary Output File.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Write Summary Record to Summary Output File

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary record has been retrieved from the database and its Account ID has been confirmed as numeric
acceptance_criteria.When: The summary record is ready for output
acceptance_criteria.Then: The complete Pending Authorization Summary record is written to the Summary Output File (Output File 1)

rules.rule_name: Reset Child Detail Records Processing Flag for New Summary
rules.rule_description: Before reading Authorization Detail child records for a new Summary record, the child-records-end flag must be reset to allow the detail processing loop to begin fresh.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Reset Child Records Flag to Continue

acceptance_criteria.Given: A valid Pending Authorization Summary record with a numeric Account ID has just been written to the Summary Output File
acceptance_criteria.When: The program prepares to read the Authorization Detail child records associated with the current Summary record
acceptance_criteria.Then: The end-of-child-segment flag is reset to its initial state so that the detail record processing loop can begin reading child records for the current Summary

rules.rule_name: Read Next Pending Authorization Detail Record for Current Summary
rules.rule_description: For each valid Pending Authorization Summary record, the program sequentially retrieves each associated Authorization Detail child record from the database.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Read Next Pending Authorization Detail Record for Current Summary

acceptance_criteria.Given: A valid Pending Authorization Summary record has been written to the Summary Output File and the child detail processing loop is active
acceptance_criteria.When: A request is made to retrieve the next Authorization Detail child record belonging to the current Pending Authorization Summary record
acceptance_criteria.Then: If a detail record is found, it is retrieved and made available for output, and the authorization summary processed counter and summary read counter are each incremented by 1; the MORE-AUTHS indicator is set to TRUE

rules.rule_name: Detect No More Detail Records for Current Summary
rules.rule_description: When all Authorization Detail child records for the current Pending Authorization Summary have been read, the program detects this condition and moves on to the next Summary record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: No More Detail Records for This Summary?

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program is reading Authorization Detail child records for the current Pending Authorization Summary record
acceptance_criteria.When: The database signals that no more Authorization Detail child records exist for the current Pending Authorization Summary
acceptance_criteria.Then: The end-of-child-segment flag is set to 'Y', causing the detail record processing loop to terminate, and the program returns to read the next Pending Authorization Summary record

rules.rule_name: Write Pending Authorization Detail Record to Details Output File
rules.rule_description: Each successfully retrieved Authorization Detail child record is written to the Details Output File.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Write Detail Record to Details Output File

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Detail record has been successfully retrieved from the database as a child of a valid Pending Authorization Summary record
acceptance_criteria.When: The detail record is ready for output
acceptance_criteria.Then: The complete Pending Authorization Detail record is written to the Details Output File (Output File 2)

rules.rule_name: Skip Invalid Pending Authorization Summary Record with Non-Numeric Account ID
rules.rule_description: A Pending Authorization Summary record whose Account ID is not numeric is excluded from all output processing, including both the summary output and all associated detail records.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Skip Invalid Summary Record

acceptance_criteria.Given: A Pending Authorization Summary record has been retrieved from the database
acceptance_criteria.When: The Account ID on the Pending Authorization Summary record is found to contain non-numeric characters
acceptance_criteria.Then: The summary record is not written to the Summary Output File, no Authorization Detail child records are read or written for this summary, and the program immediately proceeds to read the next Pending Authorization Summary record from the database

rules.rule_name: Continue Processing by Moving to Next Summary Record After All Details Are Read
rules.rule_description: After all Authorization Detail child records for the current Summary have been processed and written, the program loops back to retrieve the next Pending Authorization Summary record.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Move to Next Summary Record

acceptance_criteria.Given: All Authorization Detail child records for the current Pending Authorization Summary record have been read and written to the Details Output File
acceptance_criteria.When: The end-of-child-segment condition is detected for the current Summary
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program returns to the main processing loop and reads the next Pending Authorization Summary record from the database, continuing until the entire database is exhausted

rules.rule_name: Continuously Process All Summary and Detail Records Until Database is Exhausted
rules.rule_description: The program implements a two-level nested loop: the outer loop reads every Pending Authorization Summary record sequentially, and for each valid summary, an inner loop reads all associated Authorization Detail child records, continuing until the entire Pending Authorization database has been fully processed.
rules.sub_graph_node_text: Process All Summary and Detail Records - Repeatedly read each Pending Authorization Summary record and for each summary, read all its associated Pending Authorization Detail child records until the entire database is exhausted

acceptance_criteria.Given: The program has been initialized and both the Summary Output File and Details Output File are open
acceptance_criteria.When: The main processing loop is active
acceptance_criteria.Then: The program repeatedly reads each Pending Authorization Summary record; for each summary with a numeric Account ID, it writes the summary to the Summary Output File and then reads and writes all associated Authorization Detail records to the Details Output File; summaries with non-numeric Account IDs are skipped entirely; this continues until the end-of-database condition is reached, at which point the loop terminates and the program proceeds to close both output files

rules.rule_name: Close Authorization Summary Output File
rules.rule_description: After all Pending Authorization Summary records have been processed and written, the Summary output file must be formally closed to ensure all data is flushed and the file is properly finalized.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Close Summary Output File
OPFILE1

acceptance_criteria.Given: All Pending Authorization Summary records have been read from the database and valid records have been written to the Summary output file (OPFILE1)
acceptance_criteria.When: The program reaches the end of all processing and initiates the file closure sequence
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Summary output file (OPFILE1) is closed, making all written Authorization Summary records available for downstream consumption

rules.rule_name: Validate Successful Closure of Authorization Summary Output File
rules.rule_description: After attempting to close the Authorization Summary output file, the program must verify whether the closure was successful. If the closure fails, a business error message must be displayed identifying the Summary file closure failure.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:

acceptance_criteria.Given: A closure operation has been attempted on the Authorization Summary output file (OPFILE1)
acceptance_criteria.When: The file closure status is evaluated — a status of blank (spaces) or '00' indicates successful closure, any other status value indicates a closure failure
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the closure is successful, processing continues to close the Details output file; if the closure fails, an error message 'ERROR IN CLOSING 1ST FILE:' along with the specific file status code is displayed, and processing still continues to close the Details output file

rules.rule_name: Display Error Message for Summary File Closure Failure
rules.rule_description: When the Authorization Summary output file fails to close properly, a descriptive error message including the failure status must be displayed to alert operations staff, while allowing the program to continue closing remaining files.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Display Error Message
for Summary File Closure Failure

acceptance_criteria.Given: The closure of the Authorization Summary output file (OPFILE1) has been attempted and the resulting file status is neither blank (spaces) nor '00'
acceptance_criteria.When: The file closure status check determines the Summary file did not close successfully
acceptance_criteria.Then: An error message 'ERROR IN CLOSING 1ST FILE:' followed by the actual file closure status code is displayed; the program does not abend and continues to close the Details output file

rules.rule_name: Close Authorization Details Output File
rules.rule_description: After the Summary output file closure has been handled (successfully or with an error message), the Authorization Details output file must also be formally closed to ensure all detail records are flushed and the file is properly finalized.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Close Details Output File
OPFILE2

acceptance_criteria.Given: The Summary output file closure sequence has been completed (either successfully or with an error message displayed) and all Authorization Detail records have been written to the Details output file (OPFILE2)
acceptance_criteria.When: The program proceeds to the second step of the file closure sequence
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Details output file (OPFILE2) is closed, making all written Authorization Detail records available for downstream consumption

rules.rule_name: Validate Successful Closure of Authorization Details Output File
rules.rule_description: After attempting to close the Authorization Details output file, the program must verify whether the closure was successful. If the closure fails, a business error message must be displayed identifying the Details file closure failure.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Details File
Closed Successfully?

acceptance_criteria.Given: A closure operation has been attempted on the Authorization Details output file (OPFILE2)
acceptance_criteria.When: The file closure status is evaluated — a status of blank (spaces) or '00' indicates successful closure, any other status value indicates a closure failure
acceptance_criteria.Then: If the closure is successful, the program ends normally with all files closed; if the closure fails, an error message 'ERROR IN CLOSING 2ND FILE:' along with the specific file status code is displayed, and the program still ends normally

rules.rule_name: Display Error Message for Details File Closure Failure
rules.rule_description: When the Authorization Details output file fails to close properly, a descriptive error message including the failure status must be displayed to alert operations staff. The program completes its execution without abending.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Display Error Message
for Details File Closure Failure

acceptance_criteria.Given: The closure of the Authorization Details output file (OPFILE2) has been attempted and the resulting file status is neither blank (spaces) nor '00'
acceptance_criteria.When: The file closure status check determines the Details file did not close successfully
acceptance_criteria.Then: An error message 'ERROR IN CLOSING 2ND FILE:' followed by the actual file closure status code is displayed; the program does not abend and terminates normally after displaying the error

rules.rule_name: Sequential Closure of Both Output Files After Processing Completion
rules.rule_description: Both the Authorization Summary output file and the Authorization Details output file must always be closed at the end of processing, in a defined sequence — Summary file first, then Details file — regardless of whether individual file closures encounter errors.
rules.sub_graph_node_text:
Close Summary Output File

acceptance_criteria.Given: All Pending Authorization Summary and Detail records have been processed and the program has completed its main data extraction loop
acceptance_criteria.When: The program initiates the end-of-processing file closure routine
acceptance_criteria.Then: The Summary output file (OPFILE1) is closed first, followed by the Details output file (OPFILE2); both files are always closed regardless of any individual closure errors, ensuring no output file remains open at program termination

rules.rule_name: Authorization Detail Output File Fails to Open
rules.rule_description: When the Authorization Detail output file cannot be opened at program startup, the program must display a descriptive error message identifying the failed file and its status, then terminate abnormally.
